notes.subject: במותי
notes.rationale: 'My high places': literal mountain heights vs euphoric triumph, or ironic echo of bamot (cultic shrines); rendered literally 'ol hapsait bilong mi'.

notes.subject: חילי
notes.rationale: khail can mean strength, army, or wealth; 'strong bilong mi' chosen over 'ol samting bilong mi' (wealth).

notes.subject: למנצח בנגינותי
notes.rationale: Closing superscription ('to the choirmaster, with my stringed instruments') is a psalm-header, not part of the poem's speech.

translation: Yahwe Adonai — em i strong bilong mi; na em i putim ⟨em⟩ ol lek bilong mi olsem lek bilong ol female dia, na em i salim ⟨mi⟩ wokabaut long ol hapsait bilong mi. Bilong man i lidim singsing, wantaim ol string instrument bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: olsem lek bilong ol female dia
wantaim ol string instrument bilong mi
